text:
beth: Quickstart canary tomorrow 10:00am PT. Changelog cutoff is 9:00am PT — we need final sampleapp + docs link by 8:30. Who's owning the end-to-end smoke and CR review?

sam: I can take the smoke for the sampleapp. Need infra token + sample data. I'll run `./scripts/smoke.sh` and post results. @alex can you provision token?

alex: I can do the token. I'll create a short-lived service token in the infra account, ETA ~30m. infra-bot will post it here when done.

infra-bot: Created token redwood-quickstart-canary-2026, expires in 2h. Token: `***********` (DM for secret) (reaction :lock:)

sam: got it, thanks. Running smoke in a minute. I'll open a PR under `sampleapp/quickstart` with the test artifacts and smoke results. Any special config for canary? sequence length or quantization flags we should toggle?

julia: Docs are drafted — I just need the sampleapp docker image tag and the readme PR link. If the quickstart uses `--lite` for smaller models that's fine. I'll patch the quickstart guide to include the canary steps and the changelog blurb.

beth: Plan: sam = smoke + PR, julia = docs patch + changelog blurb, alex = token + env, katie = confirm sample data availability. katie?

katie: sample data sits in s3://redwood-quickstart/sample-data/v2 — infra role already has read access. I can carve a small subset (10 examples) for the smoke if needed.

sam: running smoke now, posting output in ~10m. Will tag reviewers on the PR once green. (thumbsup)

beth: also add a one-line automated canary test in `tests/e2e/canary.md` so we can wire this into the release job later.

alex: Token DM sent to sam and beth. Also created a short tracker issue for the CR owners and post-release followups: https://tracker/redwood/INFR-482 (ping @docs @devex).

beth: awesome — thanks everyone. If anything slips, fallback is to ship the docs with a "sampleapp coming soon" note, but prefer to include it. Reconvene here by 8:45am PT to confirm green for the changelog cutoff. /cc @everyone
